DXC Technology inaugurates AI-focused center in Bengaluru

DXC Technology has opened a new customer experience center in Bengaluru, India. The facility is designed to drive AI-led consulting services. This investment highlights India's growing role in the global technology sector, particularly in artificial intelligence.
